sanskrit_verse:
तपस्विनो दानशीलाः कुलीनाः सत्यवादिनः /
धर्मप्रधानाः ऋजवः पुत्रवन्तो धनान्विताः // YajñS_2.68
transliteration: tapasvino dānaśīlāḥ kulīnāḥ satyavādinaḥ / dharmapradhā�ā ṛjavaḥ putravanto dhanānvitāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: Those established in austerity, generosity, noble birth, truth-speaking, dharmic priority, straightness, progeny, and material sufficiency are designated as fit guardians of societal order.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Dharma, not coercive power
Causation is rooted in consciousness purity and spiritual discipline
Capacity-based responsibility arises from self-regulation and integrity
Restoration logic operates through reconnection to Dharma-rooted identity
Consciousness alignment supersedes external legal compliance
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent demonstrates tapas (self-discipline) AND dāna (generosity) THEN eligibility for custodianship increases
IF lineage attests to kulīnatva (nobility) AND satyavāda (truthfulness) THEN social testimony weight is elevated
IF dharmapradhānatva (dharmic orientation) is verifiable THEN decision-making authority is granted
IF ṛjutva (straightforwardness) is evident THEN legal standing is affirmed without corroboration
IF putravattva (progeny) AND dhana (resources) are present THEN stewardship capacity is recognized
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, fitness for leadership or judicial roles shall be assessed by these markers of inner alignment rather than procedural credentials alone. The threshold of responsibility correlates directly with demonstrated dharmic embodiment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that societal harmony flows from individuals aligned with tapas and dāna. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that neglect of such qualities leads to disorder. Responsibility is proportional to capacity cultivated. Retribution is absent; misalignment triggers automatic disqualification from authority until restoration occurs.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Tapas Rehabilitation Program to restore self-governance
Assign Dana Practice Modules to regenerate generosity circuits
Verify Kulīnatva through ancestral dharmic audit protocols
Enforce Satyavāda Immersion to reconstruct truthful speech patterns
Reintegrate Dharmapradhāna status via ritual and ethical recalibration
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse is executed as pure Dharma. Justice is restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
